_comment: Cards that exist only for the maximum-hand-size test (tests/unit/players/test_maximum_hand_size.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_hand_size_nine` is Twenty-Toed Toad's first line with a number a test hand can reach, on a free artifact so it can be cast between other effects to take a later timestamp. `t_opponents_hand_size_two` names the other seat, which is the affects_player spec's other end.
